suggestion: Replace blank market columns with a licensed feed instead of scraping
proposal: Purchase one licensed odds feed (opening + closing) and store both with hashes.
cost_or_risk: Feed cost and redistribution limits; if redistribution is barred, publish only derived residuals.
recommendation: Do it: it unblocks G4, all residuals, all CLV and the entire staking layer.

suggestion: Derive depth from snap counts, not club pages, once a source exists
proposal: One parser for a league-wide snap-count page instead of 32 club-specific parsers.
cost_or_risk: The page may not exist publicly; snap data may lag by a day.
recommendation: Preferred route (b) from the brief: verify one week, then decide.

suggestion: Publish designations as a delta series, not a level table
proposal: Keep every capture, render the change between the last two, and hide the level.
cost_or_risk: Needs >= 2 captures per week; the page has no publisher timestamp.
recommendation: Do it from Week 12: Wed/Thu/Fri captures with hashes.

suggestion: Stop publishing a 'starters out' count until starter identity is verified
proposal: The count looks authoritative and is not: it needs a depth chart.
cost_or_risk: Removing it may look like losing information.
recommendation: Do it: an unverified count is worse than a flag.

suggestion: Add a second season to the corpus before any reward is paid
proposal: Ingest 2025 official finals week by week; re-run the same frozen model.
cost_or_risk: Labour: ~18 weeks of pages; risk of rule differences across seasons.
recommendation: Do it: it is the only way to reach the 5,773-bet power threshold.

suggestion: Open-source the model as a single frozen file with a version tag
proposal: The model already lives in pipeline.py with a frozen spec id.
cost_or_risk: Readers may mistake a simple model for a naive one.
recommendation: Do it: reproducibility is the product.

suggestion: Publish the constant-mean total as the benchmark every total must beat
proposal: It beat both of our estimators on the holdout.
cost_or_risk: A benchmark that beats us is uncomfortable to publish.
recommendation: Do it: it is the honest floor.

suggestion: Score the model on MAE and Brier, never on 'picks won'
proposal: Proper scores are the only ones that cannot be gamed by selective reporting.
cost_or_risk: Readers used to win rates may find it opaque.
recommendation: Do it; explain in one sentence on the dashboard.

suggestion: Require a game-cluster lower bound, not a naive standard error
proposal: Bets on the same game are not independent; the cluster bound is wider and honest.
cost_or_risk: Wider intervals mean fewer strategies qualify.

suggestion: Cap the leaderboard at one entry per strategy family until G1 clears
proposal: Prevents a lucky variant from crowding the table.

suggestion: Replace the 1st-4th string matrix with a 'verified / unverified' board
proposal: The matrix implies knowledge we do not have; the board states what is known.

suggestion: Version depth against the last official roster event
proposal: Stamp every availability row with the transaction that could have invalidated it.
cost_or_risk: Needs the transactions hub captured daily.
recommendation: Do it; it is the brief's roster-turnover requirement.

suggestion: Add a reserve/IR list to the availability page
proposal: Absence from the report currently reads as health.
cost_or_risk: IR lists are published per club, not league-wide.
recommendation: Do it: the Lamar Jackson case shows the failure mode.

suggestion: Publish an explicit 'no certified strategy' banner until G3 clears
proposal: Prevents anyone reading the leaderboard as a tip sheet.
recommendation: Do it: it is already the case.

suggestion: Consolidate every session's strategy ledger into one register
proposal: Multiplicity adjustment is meaningless without the full trial count.
recommendation: Do it before any reward decision.

suggestion: Publish the negative results as prominently as the positive ones
proposal: The totals estimators losing to a constant mean is the most decision-relevant fact on the site.
recommendation: Do it: it is on the landing page.
